intake.goal: Draft an external email to Acme Cloud operations about a sensitive runtime incident affecting the EU customer notification pipeline, requesting specific operational checks and a status update within 60 minutes.
intake.context: Incident detected 09:12 CET on May 25, 2026. Intermittent delivery failures for transactional notifications. Still under investigation. No confirmed data loss, but delayed processing for some EU tenants. Need to confirm scope of customer-facing impact beyond the notification pipeline.
intake.domain_label: Incident notification email to operations (EU notification pipeline)
success_criteria: Email includes the required incident details (time/date, symptoms, investigation status, data-loss status, tenant impact).
Email requests the three specific actions: verify delivery queues, check retry backlog, and confirm broader customer-facing impact.
Email explicitly states a requirement to report status back to the incident lead within 60 minutes.
Email is addressed to the operations team at Acme Cloud and is suitable for external sending.
Any EU-related references (if included) use official EU sources.
constraints: Email is addressed to the operations team at Acme Cloud.

Prefer official EU sources when referencing any EU-related context or guidance.

actor.output_text: Subject: Immediate Action Required – Sensitive Runtime Incident Impacting EU Notification Pipeline (Detected 09:12 CET, 25 May 2026) Dear Acme Cloud Operations Team, We have identified a sensitive runtime incident affecting our EU customer notification pipeline, first detected at **09:12 CET on 25 May 2026**. The issue is causing **intermittent delivery failures for transactional notifications** and has resulted in **delayed processing for several EU tenants**. The investigation is ongoing; at this time there is **no confirmed data loss**. **Requested actions:** 1. **Manually verify the delivery queues** for any stuck or failed messages. 2. **Check the retry backlog** to assess the volume of pending retries and any patterns of failure. 3. **Confirm whether the impact extends beyond the notification pipeline** to any other customer‑facing services. Please provide a status update addressing the items above to the incident lead **within the next 60 minutes**. Thank you for your prompt attention to this high‑urgency matter. Best regards, [Incident Lead Name] [Title] [Contact Information]
